yard-sign.label: Yard sign
yard-sign.derivation: Estimated at roughly twenty U.S. letter stamps using the project's $0.73 2024 USPS rate; no unit price found in the single campaign-material search.

palm-card.label: Palm card
palm-card.derivation: Estimated at about one fifth of a U.S. letter stamp using the project's $0.73 2024 USPS rate; no unit price found in the single campaign-material search.

postage.label: Postage
postage.derivation: The project's campaign calibration records $0.73 per USPS letter stamp in 2024; the current local mailing rate is not compiled.

print-ad.label: Local print ad
print-ad.derivation: Estimated at the cost of 500 U.S. letter stamps using the project's $0.73 2024 USPS rate; no local rate card was found in the single campaign-material search.

filing-fee.label: Candidate filing fee
filing-fee.derivation: B01 reports a $75 Provo, Utah city-council filing-fee example; used as the unread-place fallback until candidate-filing-terms.json supplies local law.

householdCount.source: ACS 2020-2024 place population for places present in place-population-acs-2024.json, converted to households at 2.5 people per household; otherwise the current world’s recorded households at the campaign jurisdiction.
householdCount.estimatedFallback: Recorded household count from the game world; no households are manufactured.
